race.comment: LOTTERY LINK (10) showed no early muster but went through his gears impressively over the final stages to be beaten just a length last start over this course and distance. Should settle a bit closer today and although he has had a multitude of chances this looks a nice race for him. SACRED WELL (4) did his best work late to get up for third when resuming over 1350m at the Beaumont track last start. A wide gate makes it tough but is worth an each-way ticket. CASINO SHARKY (2) turned in an eye-catcher at Kempsey last time. Can improve further and play a key role. NETT'S GIRL (5) is fitter for two runs back from a spell and should enjoy a perfect run out of the inside alley. I'LLTELLYOUNOTHING (8) has only raced twice. Easily accounted for at Muswellbrook last start but is open to plenty of improvement.
